integrity_notes: Proof gives an all-length support cutoff and exhaustive finite-dimensional coefficients, with standalone Python 3 code and actual output. Published support decomposition and existence of an unspecified polynomial degree are credited, not claimed as new. Publication priority remains subject to independent scholarly verification.
scientific_limitations: Linear subspaces over prime-power finite fields only; Hamming diameter at most four. Some exceptional support coefficients are proved by exhaustive fixed-size reduced-row-echelon enumeration, rather than a symbolic type classification. No claim for general nonlinear anticodes or larger diameter.
title: Exact enumeration of linear Hamming anticodes of diameter four
